{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CgPFxAYKch4k6sTuY8Pk4","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-TransferOverdraw.md ===\n# FEATURE: Transfer Overdraw Rejection\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261025 V1 |\n| Description | A transfer larger than the source account balance is rejected with exit 3 and writes neither row. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-Transfer.md, FEATURE-LoadTransactions.md, FEATURE-LedgerCore.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | transfer overdraw rejection |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger transfer <from> <to> <amount> <date>` must never leave the source account below zero. This\nstory proves that the projected balance of the source, computed from its stored transactions minus\nthe transfer amount, is checked before the first write. A rejected transfer exits `3`, writes nothing\nto standard output, and leaves the transactions table exactly as it was. A transfer that brings the\nsource to exactly zero is allowed.\n\n## Behavior\n\n- The source balance is the sum, in integer cents, of the source account's transactions, read from\n  the database at command time.\n- If the balance minus the transfer amount is below zero, the command exits `3` before writing either\n  the outgoing or the incoming row.\n- If the source has no transactions its balance is zero and any positive transfer is rejected.\n- A transfer equal to the whole balance succeeds and leaves the source at zero.\n- No floating point is used at any step.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TXN-002` — read: list the source account's transactions to compute its balance - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `amount`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC transfer-overdraw-rejected ===\nIntent: A transfer exceeding the source balance exits 3, prints nothing, and writes no rows.\n\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    src = \"ACPTOD1\"\n    dst = \"ACPTOD2\"\n    cat = \"ACPTODC\"\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Overdraw Source\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Overdraw Target\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Overdraw Funding\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRANSFER\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    tid = max([t.txn_id for t in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=tid, date=\"2026-06-01\", account=src, category=cat, amount=10000, memo=\"\")\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", src, dst, \"100.01\", \"2026-06-02\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    after = len(db.transactions.list())\n    assert after == before\n    assert db.transactions.list(account=dst) == []\n    assert sum(t.amount for t in db.transactions.list(account=src)) == 10000\n=== END AC transfer-overdraw-rejected ===\n\n=== AC transfer-overdraw-exact-balance ===\nIntent: A transfer equal to the whole source balance succeeds and leaves the source at zero.\n\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    src = \"ACPTOE1\"\n    dst = \"ACPTOE2\"\n    cat = \"ACPTOEC\"\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Exact Source\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Exact Target\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Exact Funding\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRANSFER\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    tid = max([t.txn_id for t in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=tid, date=\"2026-06-01\", account=src, category=cat, amount=10000, memo=\"\")\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", src, dst, \"100.00\", \"2026-06-02\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before + 2\n    assert sum(t.amount for t in db.transactions.list(account=src)) == 0\n    assert sum(t.amount for t in db.transactions.list(account=dst)) == 10000\n=== END AC transfer-overdraw-exact-balance ===\n\n=== AC transfer-overdraw-empty-source ===\nIntent: A source account with no transactions cannot be the source of any positive transfer.\n\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    src = \"ACPTOM1\"\n    dst = \"ACPTOM2\"\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Empty Source\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Empty Target\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRANSFER\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", src, dst, \"0.01\", \"2026-06-02\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n    assert db.transactions.list(account=src) == []\n post, amend, delete, transfer, and load each reject any change that would leave an account balance below zero. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-TxnPost.md, FEATURE-TxnAmend.md, FEATURE-TxnDelete.md, FEATURE-TransferOverdraw.md, FEATURE-LoadRejection.md, FEATURE-LedgerCore.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | non-negative balance rule |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nAn account's balance is the sum of its transaction amounts in integer cents. No command may leave\nany account balance below zero. This assembly story confirms that every mutating command applies the\nshared projected-balance guard from the ledger core before its first write, and wires the guard into\nany command that lacks it. A rejection exits `3`, prints nothing to standard output, and leaves every\ntable unchanged.\n\n## Behavior\n\n- `txn post` rejects a withdrawal larger than the account balance.\n- `txn amend` rejects an amount that makes the resulting balance negative.\n- `txn delete` rejects deleting a deposit that the remaining transactions depend on.\n- `transfer` rejects an amount larger than the source balance.\n- `load transactions` rejects a file whose rows, taken together, leave any balance negative, and\n  stores none of its rows.\n- Each command also allows a change that brings a balance to exactly zero.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TXN-002` — read: list an account's transactions to compute balances - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `amount`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC balance-rule-post ===\nIntent: txn post rejects a withdrawal exceeding the balance and accepts one that brings it to zero.\n\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    acct = \"ACPTBP1\"\n    cat = \"ACPTBPC\"\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Post Rule\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Post Rule Category\")\n    tid = max([t.txn_id for t in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=tid, date=\"2026-06-01\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=5000, memo=\"\")\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, \"-50.01\", \"2026-06-02\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n    assert sum(t.amount for t in db.transactions.list(account=acct)) == 5000\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, \"-50.00\", \"2026-06-02\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before + 1\n    assert sum(t.amount for t in db.transactions.list(account=acct)) == 0\n=== END AC balance-rule-post ===\n\n=== AC balance-rule-amend ===\nIntent: txn FEATURE-ReportBalances.md ===\n# FEATURE: Report Balances\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261025 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger report balances`, listing each account's transaction count and balance plus a TOTAL row. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-LoadTransactions.md, FEATURE-CliEntry.md, FEATURE-LedgerCore.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger report balances |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger report balances` prints one row per account with its transaction count and balance, ordered\nby account code, followed by a TOTAL row. Every value is computed from the database at run time;\nnothing is stored or hard-coded.\n\n## Behavior\n\n- Header row: `account,name,transactions,balance`.\n- One data row per account, ordered by account code, including accounts with no transactions\n  (count `0`, balance `0.00`).\n- Final row: `TOTAL,,<count>,<sum>` where count is the total number of transactions and sum is the\n  total of all balances.\n- Balances are sums of integer cents, written with exactly two decimal places, a leading `-` when\n  negative, and no thousands separator.\n- Output is unquoted CSV with `\\n` line endings; exit `0`.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-002` — read: list every account in code order - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-002` — read: list an account's transactions to count and sum them - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `amount`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC report-balances-rows ===\nIntent: The report has one row per stored account in code order with counts and balances computed from stored transactions, then a consistent TOTAL row.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport re\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\ndef cents(text):\n    assert re.fullmatch(r\"-?\\d+\\.\\d{2}\", text), text\n    return int(Decimal(text) * 100)\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    cat = \"ACPTRBC\"\n    db.accounts.create(account=\"ACPTRB1\", name=\"Report One\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=\"ACPTRB2\", name=\"Report Two\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Report Category\")\n    base = max([t.txn_id for t in db.transactions.list()], default=0)\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=base + 1, date=\"2026-06-01\", account=\"ACPTRB1\", category=cat, amount=10000, memo=\"\")\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=base + 2, date=\"2026-06-02\", account=\"ACPTRB1\", category=cat, amount=-1250, memo=\"\")\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=base + 3, date=\"2026-06-03\", account=\"ACPTRB2\", category=cat, amount=500000, memo=\"\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"balances\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\n    data = rows[1:-1]\n    total = rows[-1]\n    accounts = db.accounts.list()\n    assert [r[0] for r in data] == [a.account for a in accounts]\n    assert [r[0] for r in data] == sorted(r[0] for r in data)\n    count_sum = 0\n    cents_sum = 0\n    for row, acct in zip(data, accounts):\n        assert len(row) == 4\n        txns = db.transactions.list(account=acct.account)\n        assert row[1] == acct.name\n        assert int(row[2]) == len(txns)\n        assert cents(row[3]) == sum(t.amount for t in txns)\n        count_sum += len(txns)\n        cents_sum += sum(t.amount for t in txns)\n    assert total[0] == \"TOTAL\"\n    assert total[1] == \"\"\n    assert len(total) == 4\n    assert int(total[2]) == count_sum\n    assert cents(total[3]) == cents_sum\n=== END AC report-balances-rows ===\n\n=== AC report-balances-empty-account ===\n\n=== AC report-balances-reflects-changes ===\nIntent: The report is computed from the database, so a new transaction changes the reported balance by its amount.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport re\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\ndef balance_of(out, acct):\n    rows = first_balance, first_count = balance_of(out, acct)\n    delta = 123456\n    tid = max([t.txn_id for t in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=tid, date=\"2026-06-04\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=delta, memo=\"\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"balances\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n overdraw rejection |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger transfer <from> <to> <amount> <date>` must never leave the source account below zero. This\nstory proves that the projected balance of the source, computed from its stored transactions minus\nthe transfer amount, is checked before the first write. A rejected transfer exits `3`, writes nothing\nto standard output, and leaves the transactions table exactly as it was. A transfer that brings the\nsource to exactly zero is allowed.\n\n## Behavior\n\n- The source balance is the sum, in integer cents, of the source account's transactions, read from\n  the database at command time.\n- If the balance minus the transfer amount is below zero, the command exits `3` before writing either\n  the outgoing or the incoming row.\n- If the source has no transactions its balance is zero and any positive transfer is rejected.\n- A transfer equal to the whole balance succeeds and leaves the source at zero.\n- No floating point is used at any step.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TXN-002` — read: list the source account's transactions to compute its balance - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `amount`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC transfer-overdraw-rejected ===\nIntent: A transfer exceeding the source balance exits 3, prints nothing, and writes no rows.\n\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    src = \"ACPTOD1\"\n    dst = \"ACPTOD2\"\n    cat = \"ACPTODC\"\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Overdraw Source\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Overdraw Target\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Overdraw Funding\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRANSFER\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    tid = max([t.txn_id for t in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=tid, date=\"2026-06-01\", account=src, category=cat, amount=10000, memo=\"\")\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", src, dst, \"100.01\", \"2026-06-02\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    after = len(db.transactions.list())\n    assert after == before\n    assert db.transactions.list(account=dst) == []\n    assert sum(t.amount for t in db.transactions.list(account=src)) == 10000\n=== END AC transfer-overdraw-rejected ===\n\n=== AC transfer-overdraw-exact-balance ===\nIntent: A transfer equal to the whole source balance succeeds and leaves the source at zero.\n\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    src = \"ACPTOE1\"\n    dst = \"ACPTOE2\"\n    cat = \"ACPTOEC\"\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Exact Source\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Exact Target\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Exact Funding\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRANSFER\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    tid = max([t.txn_id for t in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=tid, date=\"2026-06-01\", account=src, category=cat, amount=10000, memo=\"\")\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", src, dst, \"100.00\",   assert sum(t.amount for t in db.transactions.list(account=dst)) == 10000\n=== END AC transfer-overdraw-exact-balance ===\n\n=== AC transfer-overdraw-empty-source ===\nIntent: A source account with dst = \"ACPTOM2\"\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Empty Source\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Empty Target\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRANSFER\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", src, dst, \"0.01\", \"2026-06-02\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n    assert db.transactions.list(account=src) == []\n    assert db.transactions.list(account=dst) == []\n=== END AC transfer-overdraw-empty-source ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- A rejected transfer writes neither the outgoing nor FEATURE-TransferOverdraw.md, FEATURE-LoadRejection.md, FEATURE-LedgerCore.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | non-negative balance rule |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nAn account's balance is the sum of its transaction amounts in integer cents. No command may leave\nany account balance below zero. This assembly story confirms that every mutating command applies the\nshared projected-balance guard from the ledger core before its first write, and wires the guard into\nany command that lacks it. A rejection exits `3`, prints nothing to standard output, and leaves every\ntable unchanged.\n\n## Behavior\n\n- `txn post` rejects a withdrawal larger than the account balance.\n- `txn amend` rejects an amount that makes the resulting balance negative.\n- `txn delete` rejects deleting a deposit that the remaining transactions depend on.\n- `transfer` rejects an amount larger than the source balance.\n- `load transactions` rejects a file whose rows, taken together, leave any balance negative, and\n  stores none of its rows.\n- Each command also allows a change that brings a balance to exactly zero.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TXN-002` — read: list an account's transactions to compute balances - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `amount`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC balance-rule-post ===\nIntent: txn post rejects a withdrawal exceeding the balance and accepts one that brings it to zero.\n\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    acct = \"ACPTBP1\"\n    cat = \"ACPTBPC\"\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Post Rule\")\n \"2026-06-02\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n    assert sum(t.amount for t in db.transactions.list(account=acct)) == 5000\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, \"-50.00\", \"2026-06-02\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before + 1\n    assert sum(t.amount for t in db.transactions.list(account=acct)) == 0\n=== END AC balance-rule-post ===\n\n=== AC balance-rule-amend ===\nIntent: txn db.transactions.create(txn_id=withdraw_id, date=\"2026-06-02\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=-3000, memo=\"\")\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\",
